definitions: Something that initially seems problematic or negative but ultimately turns out to be advantageous or beneficial.
An apparent disadvantage that proves to be an advantage.
examples: Losing that job was more of a blessing than a curse; it led me to a much better opportunity.
The unexpected rain turned out to be more of a blessing than a curse for the parched crops.
His shyness, while sometimes awkward, was more of a blessing than a curse, as it made him a thoughtful listener.
lemma: more of a blessing than a curse
source: more of a blessing than a curse
